meta.scope: Paraguay batch 1 — Phase 0+1. Core national statistical system from INE catalogue top-down: institutional identity, EPHC (labour + poverty), IPC, national accounts anchors, and Banco Central del Paraguay. Definition locked.
meta.strategy_note: Follows NEXT-COUNTRY-STRATEGY.md after Uruguay checkpoint. Note: DGEEC was modernised into INE under Law 6770.

candidates.title: Instituto Nacional de Estadística (INE) — institutional statistical identity
candidates.description: National statistical office of Paraguay (successor to DGEEC under the modernisation of the national statistical system). Produces the core official statistics (household surveys, poverty, multidimensional poverty, census, etc.).
referenced_by: All major INE programme methodologies and technical reports
Banco Central del Paraguay publications that cite INE sources
candidates.notes: Institutional parent node for Paraguayan official statistics. Continuously cited as the producer of the principal social and demographic series. Law 6770 established the modern INE as an autonomous public-law entity.

candidates.title: Encuesta Permanente de Hogares Continua (EPHC)
candidates.description: Continuous household survey that is the primary source for labour-market indicators, household income, and income-based poverty and inequality measurement. National coverage with urban/rural and departmental domains.
candidates.notes: Central social and labour survey. Official source for both labour statistics and monetary poverty. Annual poverty results and quarterly labour bulletins are the main public products.

candidates.title: Pobreza monetaria / Monetary poverty
candidates.description: Official income-poverty and extreme-poverty incidence, calculated by comparing household per-capita income (from EPHC) with nationally defined poverty lines updated by the IPC. Published with urban/rural and departmental breakdowns.
candidates.notes: Headline social indicator. 2024: total monetary poverty 20.1% (down 2.2 pp from 22.3% in 2023); extreme poverty 4.1%. Large urban–rural gap, especially in extreme poverty (rural much higher).

candidates.title: Líneas de pobreza total y extrema
candidates.description: Monetary values of the total and extreme poverty lines (per capita), differentiated for urban and rural areas and updated with the IPC produced by the Banco Central.
candidates.notes: Direct input into the poverty measurement. Basket structures derived from income-and-expenditure surveys; annual updating uses the BCP IPC.

candidates.title: Índice de Precios al Consumidor (IPC) / Consumer Price Index
candidates.description: Monthly consumer price index measuring changes in the prices of a representative basket of goods and services. Produced by the central bank (distinct from the pure INE model in some neighbouring countries).
candidates.notes: Flagship price statistic. Produced by the BCP rather than INE. Direct input into monetary-policy analysis and into the updating of poverty lines.

candidates.title: Cuentas Nacionales / National Accounts of Paraguay
candidates.description: System of national accounts producing GDP by production, expenditure and income. Quarterly and annual releases.
candidates.notes: Core macroeconomic statistical system. BCP plays the central role in compilation and dissemination.

candidates.title: Banco Central del Paraguay — statistical publications (monetary, external, inflation)
candidates.description: Central-bank statistical output covering monetary aggregates, balance of payments, international reserves, exchange rates, IPC, and inflation analysis under an inflation-targeting regime.
candidates.notes: In the Paraguayan division of labour INE leads household surveys, poverty and census; the BCP leads national accounts, prices (IPC), monetary, external and financial statistics and conducts inflation-targeting policy (target around 3.5% ±2 pp).

candidates.title: Informe de Política Monetaria (IPoM)
candidates.description: Periodic Monetary Policy Report of the central bank. Explains recent inflation, the outlook, and the implications for the policy rate under the inflation-targeting regime.
candidates.notes: Flagship policy communication product. Complements higher-frequency monetary-policy decisions.

candidates.title: Censo Nacional de Población y Viviendas / Population and Housing Census
candidates.description: Decennial population and housing census. Provides the demographic baseline, sampling frames for household surveys, and the basis for updated population projections.
candidates.notes: Foundational demographic product (2022 census). Continuously cited by EPHC design, poverty analysis and the 2025 population-projection revision.

candidates.title: Índice de Pobreza Multidimensional (IPM)
candidates.description: Official multidimensional poverty index capturing deprivations across multiple dimensions beyond income. Complements the monetary-poverty series.
candidates.notes: Complementary structural poverty measure. Published annually for several consecutive years; series updated with the new population projections from the 2022 census.

proposed_edges.basis: Monetary poverty is calculated from EPHC household income data.
Poverty status is determined by comparing per-capita income with the official poverty lines.
Poverty lines are updated with the IPC produced by the BCP.
The Monetary Policy Report is a core publication of the Banco Central del Paraguay.
EPHC is a core continuous survey of INE.
IPC is produced and disseminated by the BCP.
Multidimensional poverty draws on household-survey information alongside other sources.
